metadata.name: VEXARQ — Lifecycle orchestrator
metadata.uso: Single entry point. It covers one phase or the full cycle. It does not replace the backlog canon or the archetype canon.

cargar.siempre: core/policies.xml, core/language.xml, core/execution-modes.xml, core/artifact-lineage.xml, core/approval-gates.xml, manifest.xml
cargar.fase: Only the XML of the active phase, its Markdown format, and the current documents that phase depends on.
cargar.no_cargar: The rest of the library, preliminaries from earlier phases, or the external backlog example as if it were the current project.

entrada.campo: Mode: validar or continuo. If missing, validar.
Profile: ligero, estandar, avanzado, or critico. If missing, classify it.

deteccion.paso: Read docs/vexarq/status.html and docs/vexarq/current/ when they exist. The most advanced phase that has its current artifact marks the starting point.
If the user names a phase, that is the working phase, provided its current inputs exist. If they are missing, stop and say which one is missing. Do not skip ahead by using preliminaries.
If there is no docs/vexarq folder and the request is to build or define a product, start at acercamiento.

If the request is a correction, a user story, or a local change on existing code, do not walk the cycle. Delegate to workflows/user-story-implementation/ or to templates/targeted-fix/, according to the scope.
Apply language.xml to every generated document, interface string, and comment meant for a person.

fases.orden: acercamiento, srs, base-de-datos, backlog, extendido, sad, arquetipo, implementacion, entrega, recomendaciones

fase.requiere: a current archetype or existing code
the earlier phases current, or the explicit close the user asks for

agrupacion_en_modo_validar.grupo: Discovery and, when the user already gave the problem in enough detail, the SRS in the same request, each as its own preliminary. Stop before data and the backlog.
Database and backlog, each in its preliminary. Stop before the extended backlog and the SAD.
Extended backlog and SAD. Stop before the archetype.
Archetype proposal, without generating the definitive code.

modo_continuo.regla: Walk the phases in order while there is no blocker.
Promote each self-checked preliminary to current/ before opening the next phase.
Include the documentation, frontend, backend, and tests that the current SAD and backlog require.

cierre_de_solicitud.regla: Update docs/vexarq/status.html using the tracker format. Little text: phase, state, link, and next action.
Write a request report from formats/reports/REQUEST_REPORT.md under docs/vexarq/reports/, with a request identifier.
Do not declare a check finished when it was not run.
Do not edit files outside the scope, and do not edit the canon.

salida.bloque: Detected phase, mode, profile, and a short reason.
Current inputs used, with their paths.
Artifact written, and whether it stayed preliminary or became current.
The concrete next action for the user.
